C1075.title: Two Sentenced for Installing Covert Camera Equipment in Hotels to Film Guests
C1075.summary: Since March 2021, defendants Yan Mouping and Yan Moujian purchased specialized covert camera equipment from e-commerce platforms and installed it in multiple rooms across three hotels to secretly film others' private activities. On December 11, the Supreme People's Court released a set of typical cases on punishing the illegal production, sale, and use of eavesdropping and covert camera devices, including this case.

references.title: Typical Cases on Punishing Illegal Production, Sale, and Use of Eavesdropping and Covert Camera Devices
